title: Product Manager
description: A practical roadmap for becoming a tech product manager: user problems, product strategy, delivery, metrics, and stakeholder communication.

tree.name: Product Thinking Foundations
tree.description: Understand users, markets, business goals, product outcomes, and what product managers actually decide.

resources.title: The Business of Building Apps - Product Management Course (freeCodeCamp)
How to Write User Stories for Product Managers (Shiksha Online)

children.name: User Research and Problem Discovery
children.description: Interview users, map pain points, validate assumptions, and separate real problems from feature requests.

children.name: Market and Business Basics
children.description: Learn competition, pricing, revenue models, positioning, and how product decisions affect business metrics.

tree.name: Roadmaps, Agile, and Delivery
tree.description: Turn product strategy into shipped increments through discovery, prioritization, user stories, and team rituals.

children.name: Prioritization
children.description: Use RICE, MoSCoW, impact-effort, opportunity scoring, and tradeoff discussions responsibly.

children.name: User Stories and PRDs
children.description: Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, release notes, and product briefs.

children.name: Practice: Feature Prioritization Memo
children.description: Compare feature ideas using user evidence, effort, risks, success metrics, and a recommended roadmap order.

tree.name: Metrics and Portfolio
tree.description: Measure product health, run experiments, communicate decisions, and build PM case studies.

children.name: Analytics and Experiments
children.description: Define funnels, activation, retention, north star metrics, A/B tests, and experiment readouts.

children.name: Project: Product Case Study
children.description: Create a product teardown or improvement proposal with research, prioritization, roadmap, metrics, and launch plan.

tree.name: Interview Practice and Career Growth
tree.description: Turn product skills into job-ready evidence through case practice, stakeholder stories, and a clear PM portfolio.

children.name: Product Case Interviews
children.description: Practice product sense, estimation, metrics, prioritization, tradeoff, and launch questions with structured answers.

children.name: Portfolio and Resume Assets
children.description: Prepare product teardowns, PRDs, roadmap slides, metrics dashboards, and STAR stories for interviews.
